Loved it
Sep 2018 • Solo
For someone who has lived in Mexico, I had high expectations. This cute open-air cantina did not disappoint. The food is Tex-Mex but with plenty of flavor and fresh ingredients, and the service was prompt and friendly. Although they can not speak Spanish they delivered tasty, chunky guacamole with small pieces of avocado, the chips were crispy and still strong enough not to break when ladened with guacamole. I ordered 2 soft shell chicken tacos but they were so generous in size I could only finish one. The chicken was tender and flavorful and the accompaniments were fresh and well-balanced. The star of the show was the wonderful garlic salsa that made the taco something special and packed an amazing picante punch. Of course the meal would not have been complete without a great local beer. A satisfying lunch at a very reasonable price. I will be back.

For Vietnam, good Mexican food
Aug 2018 • Friends
Finding good Mexican food has been a challenge in Vietnam. 
While the food here wasn’t quite as good as the Mexican food back home in California, it definitely satisfied the craving. 

I got a vegetarian burrito, wet, with chips and guacamole. The mole sauce on the burrito was more of a tomato sauce, and continuing the trend of what has been my experience with most dairy products in Vietnam, the cheese and sour cream left something to be desired. 

However, the rest was good and the portion sizes were big. Definitely plenty of food for the price. 
All in all I was pleased with the experience and would go back again.
